assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
There is concern for intermittent high-grade conduction abnormalities or silent arrhythmias
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated
The diagnosis codes I48.91, I48.0, and R55 support the clinical indication
The procedure is a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study
